summary: Vodafone Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing PDMR share transactions under its Global Incentive Plan. CEO Vodafone Business Marika Auramo acquired 1,645,690 ordinary shares at nil cost on 31 July 2026 (vesting of conditional award), then sold 775,413 shares on 3 August 2026 at GBP 1.182954 per share to satisfy tax withholding, total proceeds GBP 917,277.91. This is a routine equity-compensation vesting and sell-to-cover disclosure, not a special situation.
